text:
Aisha: Noticing several tenants in the v2 migration cohort are still getting routed to v1 when clients omit x-rw-version. Example: lighthouse-app. Console shows 40% headerless traffic.
Devon: Our routing chain is header -> tenant pin -> tenant preference -> global default (v1). We intentionally default to v1 to avoid surprising older clients.
Marco: For rollouts we should offer a per-tenant "prefer-latest-on-missing" toggle. That way teams can opt-in to be treated as v2 when header is absent during SDK upgrades.
Aisha: Agreed. Requirements: 1) routing toggle per tenant in console (opt-in only), 2) telemetry fields: requested_version (header), routed_version, version_source=(explicit|implicit|pin|global), 3) billing UI shows both requested and routed versions.
Devon: Safety nets: start with probe-weight=20% for implicit->v2, sample N=1000 requests for eval, and implement fallback-on-error that routes that single request back to v1 if v2 returns 5xx. Add an alert if fallback rate > 0.5%.
Marco: Implementation sketch for routing decision (pseudo):
```
if header:
  use header
elif tenant.flags.prefer_latest_on_missing:
  choose_v2_with_probability(p)
elif tenant.pin:
  use tenant.pin
else:
  use GLOBAL_DEFAULT
```
Where p is probe-weight.
infra-bot: run: routing-probe initiated for tenant=lighthouse-app by Devon probe=20% window=45m
Aisha: Console copy draft: "Prefer latest when client version header is missing (per-tenant). Use during SDK rollouts. This controls routing only; billing will show requested vs routed versions so you can reconcile charges."
Devon: I'll add the trace tags and make sure metrics tables expose version_source and routed_version. Marco: can you add the fallback-on-error automation and eval sampler?
Marco: On it. I'll also add a tiny regression check: compare sampled v1/v2 outputs with similarity metric; if similarity < 0.8 then auto-rollback implicit routing.
Aisha: Ops: coordinate with CS before we notify customers. Action items:
- Devon: trace tags + dashboard columns (requested_version, routed_version, version_source)
- Marco: fallback-on-error, sampler, automatic rollback rule
- Aisha: console toggle + modal copy + coordinate with CS
infra-bot: routing-probe completed - status=active probe=20%
Aisha: First 30m looks stable, sampled outputs similar, no significant 5xx increase. Will revisit after 45m and report back to CS.
